name: Isaac supervisor
story: An agent supervisor rig as it runs on 2026-08-24: a private Slack channel read from a dedicated headed Chrome by a 5-second poller loop in its own cmux pane, one supervisor isaac that routes, delegated project agents in their own cmux workspaces, a warm standby pool of five, and a health check that pulses back into the channel.

nodes.ai_reasoning: the boundary IS the story: Slack and Gmail are the only things off the laptop, so the box marks the seam

nodes.text: The poller only DETECTS. It never answers, never spawns, never moves the read marker — it just pokes.
SendMessage cannot reach the supervisor. An agent reports by driving its cmux pane.
The poller profile's Slack SSO lapses about every 5 days. It shouts LOGGEDOUT rather than going quiet.
